复习: 词、语料、分词
Recap: Words, Corpora, Tokenization

Slide 3

Recap: Word

  • Before we talk about processing words, we need to decide what counts as a word.
  • Let’s start by looking at one particular corpus (plural corpora), a computer-readable collection of text or speech (broadly speaking, of linguistic data).
  • For example the Brown corpus is a million-word collection of samples from 500 written English texts from different genres (newspaper, fiction, non-fiction, academic, etc.), assembled at Brown University in 1963–64 (Kucera and Francis, 1967). How many words are there in the following Brown sentence?

    He stepped out into the hall, where he met his brother.

  • Whether we count punctuation as words depends on the task (see Jurafsky and Martin, chapter 2).

处理词之前, 先要定下「什么算一个词」. corpus 语料库 (复数 corpora) 是计算机可读的文本或语音的集合, 广义上就是语言数据的集合. 例如 Brown 语料: 1963–64 年在布朗大学汇编, 从 500 篇不同体裁 (新闻、小说、非虚构、学术等) 的书面英语文本中取样, 共约一百万词 (Kučera 和 Francis 1967).

例句有几个词? 不算标点是 11 个, 算上逗号和句号是 13 个 (nltk.word_tokenize 实测切出 13 个 token). 标点算不算词取决于任务: 做句法分析或判断句子边界时标点很有用, 只看用词时可以去掉.

Slide 4

Recap: Tokenization

  • Tokenization: process of breaking raw text into its building parts: words, phrases, symbols, or other meaningful elements called tokens
    • Definition from Jurafsky and Martin (J&M) book: separating out or tokenizing words from running text is the task of tokenization. J&M, chapter 2

token ! = type

Types: number of distinct words; set of words in the vocabulary V; the number of types is the vocabulary of size |V|.

Tokens: total number N of running words.

Tokenisierung 分词 (tokenization) 是把原始文本拆成组成单位的过程: 词、短语、符号或其他有意义的单位, 统称 token. J&M 的定义: 从连续文本里把词切分出来. type 类符是不同的词, 所有 type 组成词表 V, type 数就是词表大小 ∣V∣; token 形符是文本里连续出现的全部词, 总数记作 N. 幻灯片的「token != type」就是 Python 的「不等于」.

Slide 5

Corpora

CorpusTypes = |V|Instances = N
Shakespeare31 thousand884 thousand
Brown corpus38 thousand1 million

Figure 2.11 Rough numbers of wordform types and instances for some English language corpora. The largest, the Google n-grams corpus, contains 13 million types, but this count only includes types appearing 40 or more times, so the true number would be much larger.

Figure from Jurafsky and Martin (J&M) book J&M, chapter 2. Note that they refer to tokens as word instances (to reserve token for subtokens). As we will not go into subtokenization algorithms, we’ll stick to the term word tokens in this lecture.

几个英语语料的词形类符数和实例数 (粗略值): 莎士比亚全集 3.1 万 type、88.4 万 token; Brown 3.8 万、100 万; Switchboard 电话对话 2 万、240 万; COCA (当代美国英语语料库) 200 万、4.4 亿; Google n-grams 1300 万、1 万亿. Google 的 type 数只算出现 40 次以上的, 真实数字要大得多. J&M 把 token 叫作 word instances, 因为他们把 token 这个词留给子词 (subtoken, 如 BPE 切出来的片段); 本课不讲子词切分, 所以仍叫 token.

读表的规律: 语料越大, type 越多, 但增长得比 token 慢得多 (Brown → COCA, token 多了 440 倍, type 只多了约 50 倍). 这正是下一页「语料越大, TTR 越低」的原因.

Slide 6–7

Type-token ratio (TTR)

TTR = number of types / number of tokens

  • Can be different in different corpora of the same language
    • The bigger the corpus, the lower the TTR
    • Text genre can have an effect
  • Also depends a lot on the language!

Type-token ratio (TTR) in different languages

Dataset* with 1000 sentences translated into different languages

LanguageTTR
Thai0.18
Indonesian0.25
English0.25
Chinese0.26
German0.31
Arabic0.33
Icelandic0.35
Russian0.40
Turkish0.44
Finnish0.48

(We’ll see a partial explanation for these differences later in this lecture)

*Parallel Universal Dependencies

Type-Token-Verhältnis 类符形符比 (TTR) = type 数 / token 数. 同一种语言的不同语料, TTR 也会不同: 语料越大 TTR 越低 (常用词反复出现, 新词越来越少), 体裁也有影响. 语言本身影响更大: 同样 1000 个互为翻译的句子 (Parallel Universal Dependencies 数据集), 泰语只有 0.18, 芬兰语高达 0.48.

这张表比较的是同一内容的翻译, 长度和体裁都控制住了, 所以差别主要来自语言的构词方式. 原因在本讲后面 (各语言的词形还原): 芬兰语、土耳其语一个词有很多屈折形式, 每种形式都算一个 type; 泰语、汉语几乎没有屈折变化. 德语 0.31 高于英语, 是格变化和复合词造成的.

Slide 8

Conditional Frequency Distributions

cfd.plot() word lengths

读图: 这是 SP 05 条件频率分布一节的复习: 条件是语言, 事件是词长. 五种欧洲语言的曲线都在词长 2–4 达到高峰, 然后很快下降; 红色的格陵兰语 (因纽特语) 曲线很平, 峰值低, 长词一直延伸到 30 多个字母, 因为它是多式综合语, 一个词常常相当于别的语言的一整句. 和上一页的 TTR 是同一个道理: 构词越「长」, 同样的意思用的词越少、越不重复.

这张图是 NLTK 书第 2 章的例子, 代码大致是 nltk.ConditionalFreqDist((lang, len(word)) for lang in languages for word in udhr.words(lang + '-Latin1')), 再调用 cfd.plot() (需要 matplotlib).

Slide 9

Word Segmentation (or Word Tokenization)

  • Tokenization of raw text, or getting a list of tokens, is almost always the first step to any NLP task, such as part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition.
  • How?
    • Word tokenization by using regular expressions
    • Word tokenization via NLTK functions (see last lecture)

把原始文本切成 token 列表, 几乎是所有 NLP 任务 (词性标注、命名实体识别等) 的第一步. 做法有两种: 用正则表达式自己切, 或用 NLTK 的分词函数 (上一讲, SP 05 · 分词与数词).

带标注的语料
Annotated Corpora

Slide 10–12

Annotated Text Corpora

Many text corpora include linguistic annotations:

  • part-of-speech tags
  • named entities
  • syntactic structures
  • semantic roles

很多语料带有语言学 Annotation 标注: 词性标签、命名实体、句法结构、语义角色. 图里是 CoNLL 格式的多层标注 (OntoNotes 风格): 每个词一行, 每一层标注一列.

读图: 第一个词 It 的 POS 是 PRP (人称代词), ParseBit 列 (TOP(S(NP*) 表示它开了一个句子、自己构成一个 NP; composed 的 POS 是 VBN, 后面几列给出它的谓词信息, PredArgs 列的 (V*) 标出它是谓词, (ARG1*) 等标出各论元; NE 列 (WORK_OF_ART* 标出一个作品名的开始; 最后一列的 (22) 之类是共指链编号. 一个句子同时带了词法、句法、语义、语篇四个层面的标注.

Slide 14

Annotated Text Corpora: Knowledge base

读图: 知识库 (knowledge base) 也是一种标注资源: 把文本里的实体归到类别下. Person 下有 Leonardo da Vinci、Michael Jackson、Christopher Columbus; Time 下有 this evening、24 hours、Tonight、a few hours; Organisation 下有 Unicef、WWF、ACL; Ordinal (序数) 下有 2781、6. 有的实体连着不止一个节点, 表示同一个字符串可能属于不同类别 (6 既可以是数, 也可以是时间「6 点」). 命名实体识别就是要给文本里的这些片段打上正确的类别.

词表
Word Lists

Slide 16–17

Word lists

word lists: special kind of lexical resources.

NLTK includes some for several languages:

  • nltk.corpus.stopwords
  • nltk.corpus.names
  • nltk.corpus.swadesh
  • nltk.corpus.words

Word lists: Stop words

Stop words: high-frequency words with little lexical content e.g., the, to, and.

(插图: 词序列 Mary had a little lamb 经过「Stopwords Filter」后只剩 Mary had little lamb, 被过滤掉的 a、an、and、are、as … 落进下方的一张清单.)

word list 词表是一种特殊的词汇资源, 就是一张词的清单. NLTK 带了几种: 停用词 (stopwords)、人名 (names)、Swadesh 核心词表、英语单词表 (words). Stoppwort 停用词是频率很高但几乎没有词汇意义的词, 如 the、to、and. 插图里过滤掉 a 以后, 句子的内容词 Mary、had、little、lamb 都留下了 (had 不在这张示意清单里).

Slide 18

Word lists: Stop words

Can you give a few examples of stop words in German?

问: 德语有哪些停用词? 答案: 冠词 der、die、das、ein、eine, 代词 ich、du、er、sie、es, 介词 in、an、auf、mit, 连词 und、oder、aber、dass, 助动词 sein、haben、werden 的各种形式 (ist、hat、wird). Slide 22 的 NLTK 德语表开头就是 aber、alle、als、also、am、an.

英语停用词表: 代词 (含所有格、反身代词)、疑问词、指示词、be 的各种形式, 还有 you're、that'll 这样的缩写. 问: 这张表大约有多少词? 课件的答案是 179.

版本差异: NLTK 的停用词数据更新过. 用现在的 stopwords 数据实际运行, len(stopwords.words("english")) 是 198, 不是 179; 而且列表改成了按字母排序, 开头是 ['a', 'about', 'above', 'after', 'again', ...], 不再是课件里从 i、me、my 开始的顺序. 德语 (232) 和 Hinglish (1036) 的数字与课件相同.

原文笔误:「How many stopwords do you except」应为 expect (预计).

停用词语料的 README: 收录多种语言的停用词表, 都是高频的语法词, 在文本检索中通常忽略; 来源是 PostgreSQL 里 Snowball 的停用词表. 第二段: 不加括号的 stopwords.words 只是一个方法对象, 并没有调用; 它所属的语料读取器指向本机的数据文件夹. 用 ls 列出这个文件夹, 每种语言一个文件.

在 Python 里列出所有语言, 不用去命令行: stopwords.fileids(). 现在的数据实测有 34 种, 比幻灯片多了 albanian、belarusian、tamil、uzbek 和 english-extended 等.

用自己机器实测时, 方法对象显示为 <bound method StopwordsCorpusReader.words of <StopwordsCorpusReader in '/Users/…/nltk_data/corpora/stopwords'>>: 新版 NLTK 给停用词专门写了一个读取器类, 路径当然也是各自的 nltk_data 目录.

Slide 22 
>>> from nltk.corpus import stopwords
>>> stopwords.words("german")
['aber', 'alle', 'allem', 'allen', 'aller', 'alles',
'als', 'also', 'am', 'an', 'ander', 'andere', 'anderem',
'anderen', 'anderer', 'anderes', 'anderm', 'andern' ...]
>>> len(stopwords.words("german"))
232

德语停用词表有 232 个 (实测相同), 比英语多, 主要因为同一个词有多种屈折形式: ander、andere、anderem、anderen、anderer、anderes、anderm、andern 各算一个.

Which language has more stop words: English or Hinglish (code-switched Hindi/English)?

答案 (先自己做再看) 
>>> from nltk.corpus import stopwords
>>> stopwords.words("hinglish")
['a', 'aadi', 'aaj', 'aap', 'aapne', 'aata', 'aati', 'aaya',
'aaye', 'ab', 'abbe', 'abbey', 'abe', 'abhi', 'able', 'about',
'above', 'accha', 'according', 'accordingly', 'acha', 'achcha',
'across', ...]
>>> len(stopwords.words("hinglish"))
1036

问: 英语和 Hinglish (印地语和英语混用的语码转换) 哪个停用词多? 答案: Hinglish, 1036 个, 远多于英语. 原因是它同时包含英语停用词 (a、about、above) 和拉丁字母转写的印地语停用词, 而转写没有统一拼法, 同一个词有好几种写法 (accha、acha、achcha 都是「好」).

Slide 24–25

Word lists: Person Names

  • Names Corpus: a word list corpus with close to 8,000 names categorized based on their gender (assuming binary gender and common (Anglophone) gender–name pairings)
  • I.e., male and female names stored in separate files
>>> import nltk
>>> names = nltk.corpus.names
>>> print(names.fileids())
['female.txt', 'male.txt']
>>> female_names = names.words(names.fileids()[0])
>>> male_names = names.words(names.fileids()[1])
>>> print([w for w in male_names if w in female_names])
['Abbey', 'Abbie', 'Abby', 'Addie', 'Adrian', 'Adrien', 'Ajay',
'Alex', 'Alexis', 'Alfie', 'Ali', 'Alix', 'Allie', 'Allyn',
'Andie', 'Andrea', 'Andy', 'Angel', 'Angie', 'Ariel',
'Ashley', 'Aubrey', 'Augustine', 'Austin', 'Averil', ...]

人名语料: 近 8000 个名字, 按性别分在两个文件里 (假设二元性别, 按常见的英语世界名字与性别的对应). 代码取出男名和女名, 再找两张表里都有的名字. 实测: 女名 5001 个, 男名 2943 个, 共 7944 个; 两边都有的 365 个, 开头和幻灯片一致.

w in female_names 每次都在一个几千项的列表里顺序查找, 先转成 set(female_names) 会快得多.

幻灯片小错: 两处输出都印成了双引号 (["female.txt", "male.txt"]、["Abbey", …]). Python 显示字符串列表时用单引号, 实际输出是 ['female.txt', 'male.txt']; 上面已按实际运行结果改正. Slide 30–31 的 Swadesh 输出也是同样的情况.

Slide 26–27

Word lists: Female and Male Names

NLP applications for which gender information would be helpful. Can you think of an example?

答案 (先自己做再看)

Anaphora resolution: Adrian drank from the cup. He liked the tea.

Machine translation: Adrian is happy. → Adrian est heureux. (vs. heureuse)

Note: Adrian is a name that occurs in both lists: female and male names.

问: 哪些 NLP 应用用得上名字的性别信息? 课件给了两个: ① Anaphernresolution 照应消解: 判断 He 指的是谁, 名字的性别是线索; ② 机器翻译: 法语形容词要和主语的性别一致, 男性 heureux、女性 heureuse. 但 Adrian 两张表里都有, 单靠名字表判断不了, 这正说明这类资源只是概率性的线索.

Slide 28–29 
import nltk
names = nltk.corpus.names
# names.fileids() contains ["female.txt", "male.txt"]
cfd = nltk.ConditionalFreqDist(
    (fileid, name[-1])
    for fileid in names.fileids()
    for name in names.words(fileid))

Code Quiz: Given this code, what is calculated in the conditional frequency distribution cfd?

答案 (先自己做再看)

代码测验: cfd 算的是什么? 答案: 条件是文件名 (female.txt / male.txt, 即性别), 事件是名字的最后一个字母 name[-1]; 所以 cfd 统计的是男名和女名各以哪个字母结尾的频率. Slide 29 的图就是 cfd.plot().

读图: 女名绝大多数以 a 或 e 结尾 (实测 a 1773 个、e 1432 个), 男名最多的是 n (478)、e (468)、y、s、d. 名字的末字母是预测性别的有力特征, NLTK 书第 6 章的性别分类器就从这个特征开始.

Word lists: Swadesh

  • comparative word list
  • lists about 200 common words in several languages.

>>> swadesh.fileids()
['be', 'bg', 'bs', 'ca', 'cs', 'cu', 'de', 'en', 'es', 'fr',
'hr', 'it', 'la', 'mk', 'nl', 'pl', 'pt', 'ro', 'ru', 'sk',
'sl', 'sr', 'sw', 'uk']
>>> swadesh.words("en")
['I', 'you (singular), thou', 'he', 'we', 'you (plural)', 'they',
'this', 'that', 'here', 'there', 'who', 'what', 'where', 'when',
'how', 'not', 'all', 'many', 'some', 'few', 'other', 'one',
'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'big', 'long', 'wide', ...]
# French - English
>>> fr2en = swadesh.entries(["fr", "en"])
>>> fr2en
[('je', 'I'), ('tu, vous', 'you (singular), thou'),
('il', 'he'), ...]
>>> translate = dict(fr2en)
>>> translate["chien"]
'dog'
# German-English
>>> de2en = swadesh.entries(["de", "en"])
# Spanish-English
>>> es2en = swadesh.entries(["es", "en"])
>>> translate.update(dict(de2en))
>>> translate.update(dict(es2en))
>>> translate["Hund"]
'dog'
>>> translate["perro"]
'dog'

Swadesh-Liste Swadesh 词表是比较语言学用的核心词表: 约 200 个各语言都有的基本词 (代词、数词、身体部位、自然现象), 每种语言按同样的顺序排列, 第 i 个词互为翻译. 文件 id 是语言代码 (de 德语、cu 古教会斯拉夫语、la 拉丁语 …). entries(["fr", "en"]) 把两种语言按位置配成 (法, 英) 对的列表, dict() 就得到一个简单的法英词典; 再用 update 并入德英、西英词对, 一个字典就能把三种语言翻成英语. 输出都已实测.

局限: 词对是整条对应的, 一条里可能有几个词 ('tu, vous'), 这时只能用整个字符串查; 只有 200 个基本词, 不能当真正的词典用.

Slide 32–33

Word lists: Words

  • NLTK includes some corpora that are nothing more than word lists that can be used for spellchecking
  • The Words Corpus /usr/share/dict/words from Unix is used by some spellcheckers.
def method_x(text):
    text_vocab=set(w.lower() for w in text if w.isalpha())
    english_vocab=set(w.lower() for w in nltk.corpus.words.words())
    x=text_vocab - english_vocab
    return sorted(x)
>>> method_x(nltk.corpus.gutenberg.words('austen-sense.txt'))
???

What is calculated in this function?

答案 (先自己做再看) 
>>> method_x(nltk.corpus.gutenberg.words('austen-sense.txt'))
['abbeyland', 'abhorred', 'abilities', 'abounded', ...]

有些语料只是一张单词表, 可以用来做拼写检查, 例如来自 Unix 的 /usr/share/dict/words. 问: method_x 算的是什么? 答案: 文本的词汇 (只取纯字母的词, 小写, 去重) 减去英语单词表, 即文本里出现了、但单词表里没有的词, 排序后返回. 对《理智与情感》实测返回 1601 个词.

结果里多数不是拼写错误, 而是单词表只收原形: abhorred、abilities、abounded 是屈折形式; abbeyland 是罕见的复合词. 所以这个函数找的是「不常见或拼错的词」, 要真正用来查错, 应该先做词形还原 (本讲后面).

NLP 流水线
NLP Pipeline

Slide 35

NLP pipeline - Stanford pipeline by C.Manning et al. (2014)

Source: https://aclanthology.org/P14-5010.pdf

读图: Stanford CoreNLP (Manning 等 2014) 的结构: 一个共享的 Annotation Object 标注对象, 原始文本 (Raw text) 放进去; 各个标注器沿执行方向 (Execution Flow, 自上而下) 依次运行: tokenize 分词 → ssplit 分句 → pos 词性标注 → lemma 形态分析 → ner 命名实体识别 → parse 句法分析 → dcoref 共指消解 → 其他 (性别、情感); 每一步读取前面步骤写进对象的结果, 再把自己的结果写回去. 最后输出带标注的文本. 顺序有依赖: 词形还原要先有词性, 句法分析要先有词性.

Slide 36–37

NLP pipeline - In more detail · Focus of today

读图: 流水线分两大块. Vorverarbeitung 预处理 (Pre-processing): 文本 → 分句 → 分词 → Normalisierung 规范化 (小写化、去停用词、词干提取、词形还原). 处理 (Processing): 词性标注之后分三支: 句法分析 (短语组块、依存分析); 特征标注 (WordNet 词义、情感、命名实体); 语义分析 (语义角色标注、语义图、词嵌入、共指消解), 最后是语篇 / 文档层面的分析 (tf-idf、相似度). Slide 37 用红框圈出预处理, 就是本讲的内容; 词性标注是下一讲.

预处理
Preprocessing

Slide 39
OriginalThe girl’s cars are different colors.
Tokenized (space)["The", "girl’s", "cars", “are", "different", "colors."]
Punctuation removal["The", "girl’s", "cars", “are", "different", "colors"]
Lowercased["the", "girl’s", "cars", “are", "different", "colors"]
Stemmed["the", "girl’s", "car", “are", "differ", "color"]
Lemmatized["the", "girl", "car", "be", "different", "color"]
Stopword removal["girl", "car", "different", "color"]

一个句子依次经过各步预处理的样子: 按空格分词 → 去标点 (colors. 变成 colors) → 小写 → 词干提取 (cars → car, different → differ) → 词形还原 (girl’s → girl, are → be, 但 different 保持不变) → 去停用词 (the、be 去掉). 最后剩下四个内容词.

这张表是示意: 每一行都建立在上一行之上, 只有「词形还原」那一行是从小写那一行重新开始, 而不是在词干上继续. 后面用 NLTK 实际做时, 结果会有出入: 默认的 WordNet 词形还原器不会把 are 还原成 be (见 Slide 54).

幻灯片小错: 每一行列表里的 “are" 开头是弯引号、结尾是直引号, 引号不配对; 作为 Python 列表应写 "are".

Slide 40

Segmentation

NLTK PunktSentenceTokenizer: divides a text into a list of sentences. This is a model created from abbreviation words, collocations, and words that start sentences.

>>> import nltk.data
>>> text = """Punkt knows that the periods in Mr. Smith and Johann S. Bach do not mark sentence boundaries. And sometimes sentences can start with non-capitalized words. i is a good variable name."""

>>> sent_detector = nltk.data.load('tokenizers/punkt/english.pickle')
>>> print('\n-----\n'.join(sent_detector.tokenize(text.strip())))
Punkt knows that the periods in Mr. Smith and Johann S. Bach do not mark sentence boundaries.
-----
And sometimes sentences can start with non-capitalized words.
-----
i is a good variable name.

Satzsegmentierung 分句: NLTK 的 PunktSentenceTokenizer 把文本分成句子列表. 它是一个从数据中学出来的模型, 记住了缩写词 (Mr.、S.)、搭配和常出现在句首的词. 例子说明了两件事: Mr. 和 S. 后面的句点不是句子边界; 小写的 i 开头也能是新句子. '\n-----\n'.join(...) 用分隔线把句子连成一个字符串再打印. 实测输出正好三句, 和幻灯片一致.

平时直接用 nltk.sent_tokenize(text) 即可, 它内部就是同一个 Punkt 模型.

幻灯片把输出印成了用 """ 括起来的斜体字符串, 但 print 不会输出引号; 上面的卡片按实际输出写. 新版 NLTK (3.9 起) 推荐用 PunktTokenizer("english") 代替加载 pickle 文件 (加载 pickle 有安全风险), 需要的数据是 punkt_tab; 在本机 NLTK 3.10 上两种写法结果相同.

Slide 41

Sentence Segmentation

And more:

>>> s = """Good muffins cost $3.88\nin New York. Please buy me\n two of them.\n\nThanks."""
>>> # same as s.split('\n'):
>>> LineTokenizer(blanklines='keep').tokenize(s)
['Good muffins cost $3.88', 'in New York. Please buy me', ' two of them.', '', 'Thanks.']
>>> # same as [l for l in s.split('\n') if l.strip()]:
>>> LineTokenizer(blanklines='discard').tokenize(s)
['Good muffins cost $3.88', 'in New York. Please buy me', ' two of them.', 'Thanks.']
>>> # same as s.split('\t'):
>>> TabTokenizer().tokenize('a\tb c\n\t d')
['a', 'b c\n', ' d']

NLTK 还有更简单的按行、按制表符切分的工具. LineTokenizer(blanklines='keep') 相当于 s.split('\n'), 空行保留为空字符串 ''; blanklines='discard' 相当于只保留非空行; TabTokenizer 相当于 s.split('\t'), 只按制表符切, 换行和空格都留在片段里. 这些工具只按字符切, 不懂语言, 用来读按行或按 Tab 组织的数据文件.

使用前要导入: from nltk.tokenize import LineTokenizer, TabTokenizer (幻灯片省略了这一行).

幻灯片错误: 幻灯片里的字符串是 …buy me\n two of them…, \n 后面有一个空格, 所以第三行实际是 ' two of them.' (带前导空格); 幻灯片两处都印成了 'two of them.', 另外把 'in New York. Please buy me' 印成了 New York. 后面两个空格. 这些输出是从 NLTK 文档抄来的, 文档里的字符串和这里的不一样. 上面已按实际运行结果改正.

规范化
Normalization

Slide 42–43

Normalization

Once the text has been segmented into its tokens (paragraphs, sentences, words), most NLP pipelines do a number of other basic procedures for text normalization, e.g.:

  • lowercasing
  • stemming
  • lemmatization
  • stopword removal

Lowercasing

>>> import nltk
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
>>> print(" ".join(lower))
the girl 's cars are different colors .

文本切成段落、句子、词以后, 多数流水线还要做几步基本的规范化: 小写化、词干提取、词形还原、去停用词. 小写化的例子: word_tokenize 把 girl's 切成 girl 和 's、把句号单独切出, 再逐个 lower(), 最后用空格连起来打印.

幻灯片小错: 这一页和 Slide 49–54、59 的 print 输出都印成了带双引号的字符串 ("the girl 's cars …"), Slide 50–54 和 59 还在开头多了一个空格. print 打印字符串不带引号, 也没有前导空格; 本笔记的卡片都按实际输出写.

Slide 44–45

Stemming and Lemmatization

  • Often, instead of working with all word forms, we would like to extract and work with their base forms (e.g. lemmas or stems)
  • Stemming and lemmatization: reduce inflectional (and sometimes derivational) forms to their base forms

Example: (ich) laufe (I run)

  • lemma: laufen
  • stem: lauf

Lemmatization

  • Lemmatization is the task of determining that two words have the same root, despite their surface differences.
  • Example: The words am, are, and is have the shared lemma be; dinner and dinners both have the lemma dinner.
  • Lemmatizing each of these forms to the same lemma will let us find all mentions of words.
  • How is lemmatization done? The most sophisticated methods for lemmatization involve complete morphological parsing of the word.
  • Morphology is the study of the way words are built up from smaller meaning-bearing units called morphemes.
  • Two broad classes of morphemes can be distinguished: stems—the central morpheme of the word, supplying the main meaning—and affixes—adding “additional” meanings (suffixes and affixes)

Src: Jurafsky and Martin, Chapter 2.

很多时候我们不想处理所有词形, 而是只用它们的基本形式 (词元或词干). Stemming 词干提取和 Lemmatisierung 词形还原都把屈折形式 (有时也包括派生形式) 归约到基本形式. 例: ich laufe 的词元是 laufen (词典里查得到的不定式), 词干是 lauf (去掉词尾后剩下的部分, 不一定是一个词).

词形还原判断两个词尽管表面不同, 却有同一个词根: am、are、is 的词元都是 be; dinner、dinners 的词元都是 dinner. 还原以后就能找到一个词的所有出现. 最精细的做法是对词做完整的形态分析. Morphologie 形态学研究词怎样由更小的有意义单位 Morphem 语素构成. 语素分两大类: 词干 (stem, 词的核心语素, 提供主要意义) 和词缀 (affix, 添加「额外」意义).

幻灯片错误: 最后一句括号里写「(suffixes and affixes)」: 词缀 (affix) 是上位概念, 不能和后缀并列当作它的两个子类. J&M 原文是 affixes 分为 prefixes 和 suffixes 等, 应为「(prefixes and suffixes)」(前缀和后缀).

Slide 46–47

The Porter Stemmer

  • Lemmatization algorithms can be complex.
  • For this reason we sometimes make use of a simpler but cruder method, which mainly consists of chopping off word-final affixes.
  • This naive version of morphological analysis is called stemming.
  • One of the most widely used stemming algorithms is the Porter algorithm.
  • The algorithm is based on series of rewrite rules run in series, as a cascade, in which the output of each pass is fed as input to the next pass.
this was not the map we found in billy bones’s chest, but
an accurate copy, complete in all things-names and heights
and soundings-with the single exception of the red crosses
and the written notes

# Porter stemmed:
thi wa not the map we found in billi bones’ chest, but an
accur copy, complet in all things-nam and height and
soundings-with the singl except of the red cross and
the written note

Src: Jurafsky and Martin, Chapter 2.

词形还原算法可能很复杂, 所以有时用一种更简单粗糙的方法: 主要就是砍掉词尾的词缀. 这种简化的形态分析叫词干提取. 最常用的是 Porter 算法: 一系列改写规则按级联方式依次运行, 每一轮的输出是下一轮的输入.

《金银岛》例句的 Porter 结果 (按空格切分后逐词实测, 结果相同) 显示了词干提取的特点: this → thi、was → wa、accurate → accur 都不是真正的词; billy → billi (把词尾 y 改成 i, 好让 billies 也归到同一个词干); crosses → cross、notes → note 去掉了复数. 规则只看字母, 不管意思.

Slide 48

NLTK Stemmers

Interfaces used to remove morphological affixes from words, leaving only the word stem.

Stemming algorithms aim to remove those affixes required for eg. grammatical role, tense, derivational morphology leaving only the stem of the word.

This is a difficult problem due to irregular words (eg. common verbs in English), complicated morphological rules, and part-of-speech and sense ambiguities (eg. ceil- is not the stem of ceiling).

Src: https://www.nltk.org/api/nltk.stem.html

NLTK 的词干提取器 (nltk.stem) 去掉表示语法角色、时态、派生的词缀, 只留下词干. 难点: 不规则词 (英语的常用动词 go → went)、复杂的形态规则、词性和词义的歧义 (ceiling 不是由 ceil- 加 -ing 构成的, 不能砍成 ceil).

Slide 49

Stemming: Implementation I

Remove morphological affixes from words, leave only the word stem

>>> import nltk
>>> def stem(word):
...     for suffix in ["ing", "ly", "ed", "ious", "ies", "ive",
...                    "es", "s", "ment"]:
...         if word.endswith(suffix):
...             return word[:-len(suffix)]
...     return word
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
>>> stemmed = [stem(x) for x in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl ' car are different color .

自己写的最简词干提取器: 按顺序检查一串后缀, 词以哪个结尾就切掉哪个, 只切第一个匹配的; 都不匹配就原样返回. 结果: cars → car、colors → color; 's 以 s 结尾, 被切成 ' (撇号), 这是规则不看上下文的典型错误.

后缀的顺序很重要: es 要排在 s 前面, 否则 boxes 只会变成 boxe. 但规则不看词本身: stem("is") 得 i, stem("this") 得 thi, stem("ceiling") 得 ceil, 正是 Slide 48 说的那种错误 (都已实测). 幻灯片在交互模式里写多行函数没有 ... 续行提示符, 上面已补上.

Slide 50

Stemming: Implementation II

>>> import nltk
>>> import re
>>> def stem(word):
...     regexp = r"^(.*?)(ing|ly|ed|ious|ies|ive|es|s|ment)?$"
...     stem, suffix = re.findall(regexp, word)[0]
...     return stem
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
>>> stemmed = [stem(x) for x in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl ' car are different color .

同样的事情用正则表达式做: ^(.*?) 是非贪婪地匹配词干, 后面的分组是可选的后缀, $ 锁定到词尾. 因为前一组是非贪婪的, 它会尽量少吃字符, 把能当后缀的部分留给第二组. findall 有两个分组时返回元组列表, 取第一个元组拆成 stem, suffix. 实测结果和实现 I 相同.

两种实现在本例和上面那几个词上结果完全相同 (实测 cries → cr、lovingly → loving、ceiling → ceil). 正则写法的好处是后缀表一目了然, 改起来方便; 缺点是 findall 加 [0] 读起来绕, 用 re.match(regexp, word).group(1) 更直接.

Slide 51

Stemming: NLTK’s stemmers

  • Porter Stemmer is the oldest stemming algorithm supported in NLTK, originally published in 1979. http://www.tartarus.org/~martin/PorterStemmer/
  • Lancaster Stemmer is much newer, published in 1990, and is more aggressive than the Porter stemming algorithm.
  • Snowball stemmer The following languages are supported: Arabic, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish and Swedish; slightly faster computation time than porter.

NLTK 的三个词干提取器: Porter 最老, 1979 年提出; Lancaster 较新 (1990), 比 Porter 更激进 (砍得更多); Snowball 支持阿拉伯语、德语、法语等 15 种语言, 计算比 Porter 略快. Snowball 的英语版也叫「Porter2」, 是 Porter 本人对原算法的改进版.

Slide 52–53 
>>> import nltk
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
# Porter Stemmer
>>> porter = nltk.PorterStemmer()
>>> stemmed = [porter.stem(t) for t in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl 's car are differ color .
# Lancaster Stemmer
>>> lancaster = nltk.LancasterStemmer()
>>> stemmed = [lancaster.stem(t) for t in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl 's car ar diff col .
# Snowball Stemmer
>>> snowball = nltk.SnowballStemmer("english")
>>> stemmed = [snowball.stem(t) for t in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl 's car are differ color .

三个提取器处理同一个句子 (实测输出与幻灯片相同). Porter 和 Snowball 在这里一样: car、differ、color, 's 不动 (它们只处理字母组成的后缀). Lancaster 明显更激进: are → ar, different → diff, colors → col. Snowball 构造时要给出语言名 "english".

怎么选: 要的是把同一个词的变体合在一起 (如检索), Porter / Snowball 够用且较稳; Lancaster 合并得多, 也更容易把不相关的词砍成同一个词干 (col 也可能来自 college).

Slide 54

Lemmatization

  • Stemming: often creates non-existent words, whereas lemmas are actual words, the “dictionary” form of a word
  • NLTK WordNet Lemmatizer uses the WordNet Database to lookup lemmas
>>> import nltk
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
>>> porter = nltk.PorterStemmer()
>>> stemmed = [porter.stem(t) for t in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(stemmed))
the girl 's car are differ color .
>>> wnl = nltk.WordNetLemmatizer()
>>> lemmatized = [wnl.lemmatize(t) for t in lower]
>>> print(" ".join(lemmatized))
the girl 's car are different color .

词干提取常常造出不存在的词 (differ 在这里碰巧是词, 但 accur、complet 不是), 而词元是真实的词, 即词的「词典形式」. NLTK 的 WordNet 词形还原器在 WordNet 词库里查词元. 对比: Porter 把 different 砍成 differ (意思都变了), WordNet 还原器保留 different, 只把复数 cars、colors 还原成单数.

易错: 输出里 are 没有变成 be. lemmatize 默认把所有词当名词 (pos='n') 查, are 当名词查不到, 就原样返回. 实测 wnl.lemmatize("are", pos="v") 才得到 be. 所以真正的词形还原要先做词性标注 (下一讲), 再把词性传进去; 这也是流水线里词性标注排在 lemma 前面的原因.

各语言的词形还原
Lemmatization & stemming in different languages

Slide 55–56

How much of an effect lemmatization/stemming has depends on a language’s morphology!

LanguageWord forms per lemma
Thai1.00
Chinese1.01
English1.18
German1.21
Indonesian1.30
Icelandic1.36
Arabic1.42
Russian1.50
Finnish1.53
Turkish1.65

Parallel Universal Dependencies – 1000 parallel sentences

  • Languages like Thai & Chinese: word = lemma, no inflection via morphemes (instead, use prepositions etc.)
  • Languages like Finnish & Turkish: lots of inflectional endings, many grammatical cases, many verb forms

词形还原 / 词干提取的作用有多大, 取决于语言的形态. 同样 1000 个平行句子, 每个词元平均对应几个词形: 泰语 1.00、汉语 1.01 (词 = 词元, 没有用语素表示的屈折变化, 而是用介词等虚词); 芬兰语 1.53、土耳其语 1.65 (大量屈折词尾、很多格、很多动词形式).

这就是 Slide 7 的 TTR 差别的部分解释: 两张表的语言顺序大致相同, 屈折越多的语言, 同一个词元分散成越多 type, TTR 越高. 对汉语做词形还原几乎没有效果, 对芬兰语、土耳其语则非常重要.

Slide 57

Example: Finnish inflection (15 cases!)

Via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finnish_grammar (CC BY-SA 4.0)

读图: 芬兰语名词有 15 个格, 英语用介词表达的关系芬兰语都用后缀: talossa (在房子里, 内格 -ssa)、talosta (从房子里出来, 出格 -sta)、taloon (进房子, 入格)、talolla (在房顶上, 所格 -lla)、talotta (没有房子, 欠格 -tta)…. 一个名词词元 talo, 单复数加上 15 个格, 就有几十个词形, 每个都是不同的 type.

Slide 58

Example: Turkish inflection & derivation

Via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkish_grammar (CC BY-SA 4.0)

读图: 土耳其语是黏着语, 屈折和派生后缀一层层往后接: Avrupa 欧洲 → Avrupalı 欧洲人 / 欧洲的 → Avrupalılaş 变成欧洲式 → Avrupalılaştır 使欧洲化 → … → Avrupalılaştıramadıklarımızdanmışsınızcasına「仿佛你们据说是那些我们没能使之欧洲化的人之一似的」. 一整句英语对应一个词. 这种语言的 type 极多, 不做形态切分几乎没法统计.

Slide 59

Stopword removal

>>> import nltk
>>> string = "The girl's cars are different colors."
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(string)
>>> lower = [x.lower() for x in tokens]
>>> wnl = nltk.WordNetLemmatizer()
>>> lemmatized = [wnl.lemmatize(t) for t in lower]
>>> content = [x for x in lemmatized
...            if x not in nltk.corpus.stopwords.words("english")]
>>> print(" ".join(content))
girl 's car different color .

去停用词: 在词形还原的结果上, 只保留不在英语停用词表里的词. the 和 are 被去掉; 's 和句号不是停用词, 留了下来 (要去掉它们得另外过滤标点, 如 x.isalpha()). 实测结果与幻灯片相同.

写法上的问题: 列表推导式每处理一个词都重新调用一次 stopwords.words("english"), 读一遍文件再在列表里顺序查找. 先写 stops = set(nltk.corpus.stopwords.words("english")) 再用 x not in stops, 长文本上会快很多.

Slide 60–61

Always Normalize?

Are there cases where it is better to not conduct some of the previously studied normalization techniques: lowercasing, stemming, lemmatization, and stop word removal?

Other Pre-processing Libraries

Apart from NLTK, further Python libraries are available for reliable pre-processing:

  • spaCy: designed for production use, visualization components, support for 70+ languages
  • stanza: from the Stanford group, GPU support, based on neural networks, interface to Stanford CoreNLP Java API
  • and many more..

Feel free to play around with these tools!

问: 有没有不该做某些规范化的情况? 答案: 有, 要看任务. ① 小写化会丢掉信息: 命名实体识别里 US (美国) 和 us (我们)、Apple 和 apple 靠大小写区分; 德语名词大写也是词性线索. ② 词干提取 / 词形还原会丢掉时态、数等信息: 词性标注、句法分析、机器翻译都需要原来的词形. ③ 去停用词会改变意思: 情感分析里 not 是停用词, 去掉后 not good 变成 good; 作者识别 (文体学) 里虚词频率恰恰是最重要的特征; 短语检索 (To be or not to be) 全是停用词. 现代神经网络模型 (BERT、GPT) 通常直接用原始文本加子词切分, 几乎不做这些规范化.

除了 NLTK, 还有可靠的预处理库: spaCy (面向生产环境, 带可视化组件, 支持 70 多种语言); stanza (斯坦福组开发, 基于神经网络, 支持 GPU, 带有调用 CoreNLP Java 接口的功能).

搭配与二元组
Collocations and Bigrams

Slide 63–65

Collocations and Bigrams

  • Collocation: sequence of words that occur together unusually often
  • red wine: collocation ≠ the wine: no collocation.
  • Collocations: resistant to substitution with words that have similar senses; e.g., maroon wine sounds very odd

Collocation vs Concordance – What is the difference?

Reminder: Concordance

  • Concordance: A list of all occurrences of a given word together with its context. Also known as keyword in context.

Kollokation 搭配是异常频繁地一起出现的词序列: red wine 是搭配, the wine 不是 (the 和什么都能连). 搭配不容易用近义词替换: 把 red 换成意思相近的 maroon (栗色), maroon wine 就很别扭.

问: 搭配和索引有什么区别? 答案: Konkordanz 索引 (concordance, 也叫 keyword in context) 是针对一个给定的词, 列出它的每一次出现和上下文, 是一种查看工具 (SP 05 · 索引); 搭配是从整个文本里统计出来的、比偶然更常一起出现的词组, 是一种分析结果. 索引回答「这个词怎么用」, 搭配回答「哪些词经常一起出现」.

Slide 66

Collocations and Bigrams, Trigrams, N-grams

  • Bigrams: a list of consecutive word pairs extracted from a text
  • Trigrams: 3 consecutive words extracted from a text
  • 4-grams, 5-grams, etc. - generally called n-grams: list of n words
  • Collocations: frequent bigrams
>>> from nltk import bigrams
>>> list(bigrams(["more", "is","said", "than", "done"]))
[('more', 'is'), ('is', 'said'), ('said', 'than'),
('than', 'done')]
>>> from nltk import trigrams
>>> list(trigrams(["more", "is","said", "than", "done"]))
[('more', 'is', 'said'), ('is', 'said', 'than'),
('said', 'than', 'done')]

Bigramm 二元组是文本里相邻两个词组成的对的列表, 三元组是相邻三个词, 一般地叫 N-Gramm n 元组. n 个词的文本有 n−1 个二元组、n−2 个三元组. bigrams 和 trigrams 返回的是生成器, 要用 list() 才能看到内容 (实测输出与幻灯片相同).

「搭配就是频繁的二元组」是简化的说法: 只按频率排, 最前面的会是 of the、in the 这类停用词组合. NLTK 的 text.collocation_list() 会先过滤停用词, 并用互信息之类的统计量衡量两个词是不是「比偶然更常」在一起.

用二元组生成随机文本
Generating Random Text with Bigrams

Slide 67–70

1. Treat each word as a condition:

>>> import nltk
>>> text = nltk.corpus.genesis.words("english-kjv.txt")
>>> bigrams = nltk.bigrams(text)
>>> cfd = nltk.ConditionalFreqDist(bigrams)
>>> print(cfd.conditions())
['In', 'the', 'beginning', 'God', 'created', ...]
>>> print(list(cfd["living"]))
['creature', 'thing', 'soul', '.', 'substance', ',']
>>> print(list(cfd["living"].values()))
[7, 4, 1, 1, 2, 1]
>>> result = cfd["living"].max()

6 words with condition “living”: living creature, living thing, living soul, ...

living creature = 7 times, living thing = 4 times, ...

Token ‘creature’ the most probable in this context

第一步: 把每个词当作条件. 对《创世记》(钦定版英译) 生成全部二元组, 交给 ConditionalFreqDist: 每个二元组 (前词, 后词) 中前词是条件, 后词是事件. 于是 cfd["living"] 就是 living 后面跟过的词的频率分布: creature 7 次、thing 4 次、substance 2 次, soul、句号、逗号各 1 次, 共 6 种. max() 返回最频繁的那个: creature.

注意变量名 bigrams 在这里遮住了 nltk.bigrams 函数 (因为是用 nltk.bigrams 调用的, 这一次没出问题). 另外 nltk.bigrams 返回生成器, 只能用一次: 交给 cfd 之后它就空了.

版本差异: 在 NLTK 3.10 上实际运行, list(cfd["living"]) 得到的是 ['creature', 'thing', 'substance', 'soul', '.', ','], 而 list(cfd["living"].values()) 仍是 [7, 4, 1, 1, 2, 1]. 新版 FreqDist 遍历时按频率从高到低 (substance 2 次排到了 soul 前面), 而 values() 仍按第一次出现的顺序, 两个列表不再一一对应. 幻灯片的输出是旧版按出现顺序遍历的结果. 要词和次数配对, 应该用 cfd["living"].items() 或 most_common(): 实测 {'creature': 7, 'thing': 4, 'soul': 1, '.': 1, 'substance': 2, ',': 1}.

Slide 71–72

2. Pair each word with the one that is most probable to be following it, as this is measured by the conditional frequency distribution

>>> import nltk
>>> def generate_model(cfdist, word, num=15):
...     for i in range(num):
...         print(word, end=' ')
...         word = cfdist[word].max()
>>> text = nltk.corpus.genesis.words("english-kjv.txt")
>>> bigrams = nltk.bigrams(text)
>>> cfd = nltk.ConditionalFreqDist(bigrams)
>>> generate_model(cfd, 'living')
living creature that he said , and the land of the land of the land

The generated text is “living creature that he said , and the land of the land of the land”. Is this satisfactory – why / why not?

第二步: 从一个词出发, 每次打印当前词, 然后换成「最常跟在它后面的词」, 共 15 次. 从 living 开始: creature 之后最常见的是 that, 然后 he、said、逗号、and、the、land、of、the、land …. 实测输出与幻灯片一致.

问: 这个结果令人满意吗? 答案: 不满意. ① 很快陷入循环: the → land → of → the …, 因为每一步都确定地选最大值, 一旦回到同一个词, 后面就完全重复. ② 只看前一个词, 没有更长的上下文, 局部通顺, 整体没有意思. 改进: 按频率随机抽下一个词, 而不是总取最大值 (函数名里的 random 本来就是这个意思, 现在的写法其实一点也不随机); 用更长的上下文 (三元组、n 元组); 这也正是语言模型的基本思想, 现代语言模型就是用很长的上下文预测下一个词的概率分布再抽样.

逐条对应本笔记的位置:

  • Corpora, tokenization: 能区分 type 和 token, 会算 TTR 并解释它为什么随语料大小和语言变化 (复习).
  • Annotated corpora: 能说出常见的标注层 (词性、命名实体、句法、语义角色), 会用 nltk.download 取语料 (带标注的语料).
  • Word lists: 会用 stopwords、names、swadesh、words 四种词表写小程序, 如找两性通用的名字、按末字母统计性别、简单翻译 (词表).
  • NLP pipeline: 能说出预处理各步的顺序和依赖 (NLP 流水线).
  • Preprocessing: 能用 NLTK 做分句、小写化、三种词干提取、WordNet 词形还原、去停用词, 能解释词干和词元的区别, 以及什么时候不该规范化 (预处理).
  • Concordance vs. collocation: 能讲清两者的区别, 会生成二元组和三元组 (搭配与二元组).
  • Generating text with bigrams: 能写出 generate_model, 并解释它为什么会陷入循环 (生成随机文本).
